description: Focus stays in the message input after pasting an image. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /new and wait for the message input (data-testid "message-input") to be visible. 2. Fill it with "Testing paste focus: " (note the trailing space), which focuses it. 3. In an eval, dispatch on the message input new ClipboardEvent("paste", {clipboardData: dt, bubbles: true, cancelable: true}), where dt is a new DataTransfer holding new File([new Blob(["test"], {type: "image/png"})], "test-paste.png", {type: "image/png"}). 4. Wait 100ms. 5. The message input must be the focused element (document.activeElement === the message input is true). 6. Its value must still be exactly "Testing paste focus: ". 7. There should be exactly one attachment chip (".message-attachment").

steps.expression: (function() { var input = document.querySelector('[data-testid="message-input"]'); var file = new File([new Blob(['test'], {type: 'image/png'})], 'test-paste.png', {type: 'image/png'}); var dt = new DataTransfer(); dt.items.add(file); var ev = new ClipboardEvent('paste', {clipboardData: dt, bubbles: true, cancelable: true}); input.dispatchEvent(ev); return 'dispatched'; })()
